Title: Neutrino AI
Description: Neutrino AI is an AI-powered dual chatbot platform that provides personalized mental health and nutrition support. It features a Mental Health Chatbot that uses sentiment analysis to offer emotional assistance, mindfulness exercises, and stress-management guidance, alongside a Nutrition & Diet Chatbot that delivers personalized meal plans, calorie tracking, and fitness recommendations. Built with Django, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap, the platform includes secure user authentication, database integration, and a responsive interface for a seamless experience across web and mobile devices.

Title: EDU AI
Description: EDU AI is an AI-powered educational platform designed to enhance learning, productivity, and career development through a suite of intelligent study tools. It provides features such as AI-generated short notes, interactive chatbot assistance, personalized learning pathways, quiz generation, homework solving, smart flashcards, focus tools, and career guidance. Built with modern web technologies including Node.js, Express.js, and AI integrations such as OpenAI and Gemini APIs, the platform delivers real-time, personalized academic support through a responsive and user-friendly interface. EDU AI combines advanced AI capabilities with seamless user experience to help students learn smarter, stay focused, and achieve their academic and professional goals.

Title: Portfolio Website
Description: This is a modern, full-stack portfolio platform built using Next.js, Node.js, Prisma, and advanced web technologies to showcase professional skills, experience, projects, and achievements. The platform features dedicated sections for Home, Bio, Education, Experience, Skills, Projects, Achievements, and Contact, all presented through a sleek, responsive, and interactive user interface. Enhanced with dynamic animations, optimized performance, and scalable architecture, it delivers an engaging user experience across all devices. Leveraging modern development practices, database integration, and server-side capabilities, the project demonstrates both technical expertise and creative design in a single professional portfolio solution.

Title: Unicorn
Description: UNICORN is a startup-building platform that helps founders transform ideas into scalable businesses through a complete suite of tools covering ideation, validation, MVP planning, branding, marketing, funding, launch, and growth. Built with a local-first, backend-free architecture, it operates entirely in the browser, ensuring privacy, offline access, and instant setup. The platform features AI-inspired deterministic generators, startup valuation tools, pitch deck creation, interactive Kanban boards, and progress dashboards. Developed using React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, Dexie, and React Flow, it offers modular design, local data persistence, and export capabilities in PDF, JSON, and SVG formats. Deployable on any static hosting platform, UNICORN provides a seamless and scalable environment for startup development. License: MIT.

Title: VoiceUp India – Citizen Engagement Platform
Description: VoiceUp India is a civic-tech platform that connects citizens with government bodies to report, track, and resolve public issues. Users can submit complaints with location, category, descriptions, and media attachments, while communities engage through voting and discussions. The platform provides interactive maps, geospatial analytics, and real-time dashboards to identify regional trends and monitor issue resolution. Government ministries gain access to data-driven insights for better decision-making. An AI-powered chatbot assists with civic queries and public data analysis. Built with React, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, and React-Leaflet, the platform supports real-time synchronization, secure APIs, offline-ready functionality, and scalable deployment on platforms like Vercel and Netlify. Licensed under MIT.
